items.title: ARC-019 precondition: LIVE closed-loop validation of the 591f crossing-count Phase 0->1 curriculum gate (crossing-count vs legacy spike, matched seeds)
items.note: ARC-019 NON-DEGENERACY PRECONDITION probe (the claim's own what_would_answer requires it verified before any staged-vs-unstaged outcome comparison counts as evidence). Discriminative pair per EVB-1189: ARM_CROSSING (591f crossing-count>=3 gate, wired LIVE via InfantCurriculumScheduler(phase_0to1_use_crossing_count=True)) vs ARM_SPIKE (legacy single-episode spike gate, control), matched seeds 42-46, diversity-armed 591c build. GOV-REUSE-1 / Step 2.4: decisive readout = per-seed LIVE Phase 0->1 advance decision under the crossing-count gate. Checked v3_exq_591f_..._20260615T115131Z_v3 (per_seed_criteria carries a crossing_count advanced/at_episode column for all 5 seeds) plus 591b/591c/591d/591e. NOT recoverable: 591f's crossing_count column is an OFFLINE replay over telemetry generated by a run whose scheduler used the LEGACY gate, and the scheduler feeds phase back into novelty_bonus_weight (0.5 Phase0 -> 0.7 Phase1). Seeds 42/43 replay-advance at ep 133/138 vs spike advance at 104/114, so 24-29 episodes inside their decision window were generated at 0.7 while a true crossing-count run holds them at 0.5 -- against a margin of only 7 and 6 crossings vs a floor of 3. The landed contract (test_infant_curriculum_gap9.py 'matches-591f-offline-replay') pins the replay arithmetic, not closed-loop behaviour. -> run. SUBSTRATE: knob landed via /implement-substrate (ree-v3/CLAUDE.md, 27/27 contracts); probe confirmed live (3 crossings->Phase1, 2->Phase0). Step 2.5c: corrupting entries mode-governance-engagement and SD-082 overlap ree_core/agent.py at module level but were verified UNREACHABLE in this config (cfg.use_salience_coordinator=False; agent.lateral_pfc is None). Open DEGRADING defects on exercised paths, run proceeds under them: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING and mech357-freeze-incompatible-pressure-mechanism (ree_core/environment/causal_grid_world.py, utils/config.py, agent.py) and sd_epistemic_deficit_multitarget_readiness (ree_core/policy/structured_curiosity.py, which this run enables). Re-derive brake: 0 counted autopsies on ARC-019. red-team (fable): CONTESTED -> F1 (no live-false-advancer precondition, so the gate's REJECT leg could go unchallenged while minting the strongest PASS label) FIXED by adding precondition P5 live_false_advancer_present with a frozen-591f anchor; F2 (precondition text still described the superseded pre-ep_min oracle window while the code used full-run) FIXED, and ORACLE_WINDOW_END moved to informational_only; F4 (infant_curriculum._try_phase_0_to_1 advances unconditionally on a missing-telemetry episode, bypassing the crossing count) FIXED by a dropout_bypassed guard that refuses the criterion and routes to substrate_not_ready_requeue; F3 (outcome=FAIL cannot separate 'control did not reproduce' from 'gate refuted', and the label's 'requeue' is read by nothing) DISMISSED as lineage-wide and mis-stated -- the distinction lives in interpretation.preconditions[], which build_experiment_indexes._precondition_unmet recomputes into adjudication=precondition_unmet; recorded in the manifest's verdict_routing_note. SCOPE: env_kwargs() is informational-only (faithful to 591b-591f; only the original 591 applied it), so this validates the Phase 0->1 GATE, not the full staged curriculum -- ARC-019's staged-vs-unstaged outcome comparison stays out of scope and substrate-gated, hence evidence_direction non_contributory. COST: ~23h extrapolated from a Mac-measured 0.258 s/step over 10 cells x 160 ep x 200 steps; estimated_minutes is approximate. Smoke PASS (exit 0); validate_experiments --strict clean.
